requested_changes.body: This commented code needs to be uncommented and implemented. The JIT path (lines 1956-1976) properly ignores errors on absent keys for `optout: "optional"` schemas, but the non-JIT path doesn't. This means `z.object({a: z.string().exactOptional()}).parse({})` will fail in jitless mode but succeed in JIT mode. The parameter `isOptionalOut` should be computed from `el._zod.optout === "optional"` and passed to this function.

This line is commented out but needs to be active. You need to compute `isOptionalOut` here and pass it to `handlePropertyResult` so the non-JIT path matches the JIT path behavior. Without this, tests at lines 177-185 of optional.test.ts will fail in jitless mode.

This implementation is too simplistic. While it correctly delegates to the inner type (rejecting explicit `undefined`), the issue is that when used in an object context, the object parser needs to know this is an `exactOptional` to suppress errors on absent keys. The current approach relies on `optout === "optional"` being set (which happens via parent init), but the logic to check this in the non-JIT object parser is commented out. Either uncomment that logic or document why the current approach is sufficient.
